title: Why Is the Body a Layered and Finite Reality Carrier?
summary: The body can sustain Runtime because it has interacting layers, boundaries, exchange, regulation, and Feedback, while every layer remains limited by capacity, speed, resources, and recovery. Finitude describes Carrier conditions, not Identity or personal value.
shortAnswer: The body can sustain Runtime because it has interacting layers, boundaries, exchange, regulation, and Feedback, while every layer remains limited by capacity, speed, resources, and recovery. Finitude describes Carrier conditions, not Identity or personal value.
displayQuestion: Why Is the Body a Layered and Finite Reality Carrier?

sections.heading: 正文
paragraphs: The body is not an unlimited, transparent, single-layer container. PHI OS describes it as a Reality Carrier for ongoing Runtime: different layers connect through boundaries, exchange, regulation, and Feedback, while each layer has limits of capacity, speed, resources, and recovery. The body consists of multiple interdependent but non-interchangeable Carrier layers.

sections.heading: Layered Carrier is not single-layer determinism
paragraphs: Material Structure, physiological regulation, sensation and Agency interfaces, and resource or recovery boundaries can participate at different scales. They depend on one another without becoming interchangeable. Higher-level operation relies on lower-level support, and changes at one layer can affect the whole through interfaces.

Layer dependence is not single-layer determinism. A Carrier hierarchy describes dependence and connection; it does not establish that one bodily layer controls the entire body, consciousness, Identity, or behavior.

sections.heading: Boundaries and Feedback connect the layers
paragraphs: Boundaries, exchange, regulation, and Feedback connect the layers. Boundaries preserve distinctions while allowing necessary exchange. Regulation lets the system respond to changing conditions, and Feedback allows a change at one layer to influence later adjustment.

These connections support Continuity, but Continuity is not unlimited capacity. Reality is carried through finite Structure, and every concrete Carrier filters, delays, and limits some states while enabling others.

sections.heading: Capacity, resources, and recovery shape sustainable states
paragraphs: Capacity, speed, resources, and recovery limits shape the states a Carrier can sustain. Whether a Runtime state can continue depends on operating conditions, not merely on an abstract intention to continue. This is a general mechanism boundary, not medical interpretation.

A general Runtime mechanism is not a medical fact or diagnosis. Specific anatomical, physiological, neurological, metabolic, or health claims require evidence and professional assessment appropriate to those domains and cannot be inferred from a general framework alone.

sections.heading: Carrier is not Identity
paragraphs: Bodily limitation is not Identity, moral value, or personal failure. Carrier describes conditions of support. Identity belongs to a different question. Limited capacity does not establish a defect of character, will, morality, or worth.
Carrier is not Identity, and finitude is not a defect-value judgment. Finitude is a condition of every concrete Carrier, not a scale for ranking a person.

sections.heading: Feedback and recovery support continued Runtime
paragraphs: As a Reality Carrier, the body uses Feedback to adjust states and requires resources and recovery boundaries for continued operation. Agency and sensation-action interfaces allow the Carrier to act in relation to its environment, but action remains bounded by Structure, resources, and recovery conditions.
Recognizing those limits protects the distinction between operating conditions and Identity. A finite Carrier can be supported, reorganized, or restored without treating limitation itself as failure.

sections.heading: A finite Carrier makes experience and action possible
paragraphs: The body's layers and boundaries create limits, but they also make Reality experienceable and actionable through a concrete Carrier. Structure provides support, Feedback provides adjustment, and resource or recovery conditions support Continuity. The body is therefore both a basis for Runtime and a boundary that Runtime must respect.
